subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Ms. Park said the room did not change much.”?
options: Sometimes it works best when people barely notice it.
They are systems people pass through, sometimes easily and sometimes not.
Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.
Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
